facts.text: I am planning a project in Nigeria that connects 100 rural villages to running water.
I am asking who the stakeholders are that will benefit or be harmed by the project.
I want the response in an array format.
I want the stakeholders organized in a table with columns for Stakeholders title, Stakeholder type (business/non profit/gov/individuals), and a short description of potential benefit or harm.
I want each stakeholder row broken into potential indicators to measure the impact.
I want the indicators done for all stakeholders.

keyphrases: stakeholder type business non profit gov individuals
